brief:
Britain will unveil a "comprehensive" package of measures addressing Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank in the coming weeks, Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announced Tuesday. Speaking to lawmakers, Miliband signaled intensified British scrutiny of settlement expansion, with particular focus on the E1 development, according to Al-Monitor.

The specifics of the proposed measures remain undisclosed at this stage. The announcement reflects growing international concern over Israeli settlement activity in Palestinian territories, an issue that has drawn criticism from multiple governments and international bodies seeking to preserve prospects for a two-state solution.
